summary: FINAL PRODUCTION VERIFICATION on https://parasreward.com after 3rd hot-fix deploy. RESULT: PASS — Zero MongoDB internals leaked to UI across all flows. Admin login OK. /admin/user360 initial load is clean (no error toast/card). Search 9696969696 (admin's own heavy profile) eventually rendered full data (Company Manager, UID, KYC, Wallet, Risk Score) at ~36s; cached re-search at 2.5s. During the cold load two 503 responses appeared in the console, but the UI showed only the loading spinner and ultimately succeeded — no raw MongoDB strings were ever visible to the admin. Search 0000000000 surfaced a clean 'User not found. Please check your search query.' message at ~8s. Login-As-User: digit '9696' returned 4 results in ~0.3s; name 'test' returned 4 results in ~0.3s. NO 'Search failed' toast surfaced anywhere. FORBIDDEN_LEAKS scan (customer-apps-shard / mongodb.net / shard-00 / shard-01 / 27017 / read operation timed out / hfzqpg) over ~80 polling samples of body innerText + all toast/alert/error nodes returned 0 hits. Sanitizer + client regex working as designed.

minor.issue: Cold first-load still produced two 503 responses (console) before eventually returning 200 — total ~36s wall-clock from Enter to fully rendered profile. Subsequent (cached) calls returned in 2.5s. UX is acceptable because the spinner stays visible and no error leaks, but Atlas warm-up / index-selection on the admin's heavy profile is still the slowest path. Consider pre-warming on admin login or background refresh.

issues: Two 'Search' affordances on the page (top-right small Search button + main orange Search button next to the input). Cosmetic only, can be deduped to a single primary Search action.

action_items: (Optional, non-blocking) Pre-warm the user-360 admin's own profile cache during admin login or in a background warmer to avoid the 30s+ cold-load on the first visit.
(Cosmetic) Remove or rename one of the two 'Search' buttons on /admin/user360 to avoid duplicate primary actions.
critical_code_review_comments: Sanitizer pattern (server-side _sanitize_unhandled_errors + _sanitize_http_exceptions and client-side regex in AdminUser360New / AdminLoginAsUser) is robust — verified zero leakage even when backend returned 503 mid-flow.

Even though no MongoDB strings leak, two 503s on the same request before success indicates the FE is silently retrying. Confirm retry budget is bounded (max 2-3) so a hard outage doesn't tie the spinner up indefinitely; consider surfacing the friendly 'Database is busy right now' card after the retry budget is exhausted.
Consider adding a hard client-side timeout (e.g. 40s) so that pathological hangs eventually render the friendly error card rather than perpetual spinner.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all 4 test scenarios from the request PASS

context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified on prod https://parasreward.com 2026-01 final-deploy hot-fix #3. Forbidden-string scan = 0 leaks across initial-load, admin-own search, not-found search, cached re-search, login-as-user digit search, login-as-user name search. No 'Search failed' toast. No raw MongoDB strings. No HTTP 500 surfaced raw. Cold admin-own user-360 takes ~36s end-to-end (with internal retries) but spinner stays clean and full data renders. Cached load: 2.5s. Impersonation digit & name: ~0.3s each. Recommended re-test only if the sanitizer or AdminUser360New error path is touched again.
rca of the issue: Original bug (visible 'customer-apps-shard-00-01.hfzqpg.mongodb.net:27017: read operation timed out' string in the toast on /admin/user360) is RESOLVED. Backend GLOBAL exception handlers (_sanitize_unhandled_errors + _sanitize_http_exceptions in /app/backend/server.py ~line 1058) replace any MongoDB shard/timeout text with the friendly 'Database is busy right now. Please try again in a few seconds.' string. Frontend AdminUser360New.js (~line 492) and AdminLoginAsUser.js (~line 50) add a defensive client-side regex strip as a second line of defense. Verification method: a Playwright run polled document.body.innerText and every visible [role=alert]/[role=status]/.toast/.error/.notification node every second across all six test scenarios; the substrings 'customer-apps-shard', 'mongodb.net', 'shard-00', 'shard-01', '27017', 'hfzqpg', 'read operation timed out' produced 0 hits in any sample. The remaining slowness on the admin's own cold profile (~36s, two 503 retries) is a separate performance issue and is NOT a leak — UX-wise the user only sees a spinner followed by the rendered profile.
